text.tspan: Net official development assistance (ODA) from governments and multilateral organizations, grants from civil
society organizations. This data is expressed in US dollars and adjusted for inflation.
Note: This data is expressed in constant 2024 US$. From 2018, the official reporting method switched from net to grant-equivalent amounts.
